caption:
Asian Greens Chicken Stir Fry
one pot recipe that takes less than 30 minutes and has barely any prep required 
high protein|low carb
C: 11 | F: 8 | P:34 
Makes 3 portions

Ingredients:

1 tsp oil, sesame gives some great flavour
450 grams chicken breast, chopped into small cubes (replace with paneer or tofu for vegetarian options)
1 tsp garlic + 1 tsp ginger paste
3 sprigs of spring onion, finely sliced only greens
handful of spinach leaves, shredded
2 bunches of bok choy
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice wine vinegar
2 packets chilli flakes 
1/2 cup water/chicken/veg stock
slurry - 1 tsp cornflour + 3 tbsp water 

Method: 

add oil to the pan and add in the ginger and garlic paste
add chopped chicken and saute till almost cooked through ( around 4 - 5 minutes) 
once the chicken is done, add in your spring onion, spinach and bokchoy and cover and cook for 5-6 minutes till done
mix in the soy sauce, vinegar and chilli flakes
follow that up with the stock / water (to give the dish some gravy if eating with rice / noodles else this can be omitted)
finish with your cornflour slurry, i use barely 1 tsp of cornflour to this as i want a thin gravy. feel free to add 2 tsp for a thicker gravy
